purpose: Provide the reusable protected-route and context-builder seams that later product features must call before Farm/Plant data access.
success_outcome: Later routes and context builders can require ActorContext and produce safe authorization-scoped context without leaking auth material.

forbidden_scope: Agent Chat Bus event payload implementation
raw auth material in context output

commands: Check changed code preserves verified FT-000 app/settings/database/session/redaction baseline or records a blocker.
success_checks: Protected route dependency fails closed for missing, invalid, expired, pending, disabled, or membership-disabled sessions.
Context builders use ActorContext and PlantPermissionContext before returning scoped context.
Bus/context-builder output excludes session IDs, tokens, token hashes, password hashes, auth headers, cookies, UI Feed, raw chat, and unapproved proposal content.
Unauthorized Plant context is filtered before Bus/model context is prepared.
T3 closure includes /verify PASS, /red-verify semantic-pass, HUMAN_CHECKPOINT: done, and ROLLBACK_RECOVERY_NOTE: present.

stop_conditions: Context-builder authorization cannot be proven before data exposure.
Auth material exclusion cannot be tested.
Implementation requires owning FT-007/FT-008 agent publication behavior.
Implementation contradicts verified FT-000 app/settings/database/session/redaction baseline.
